attackers_goals: Download a second stage payload for execution.
description: A process was executed with an uncommon GitHub URL in its command line. This may have legitimate uses, but it might also be used by attackers to download malicious payloads.
investigative_actions: Check if the initiator process is malicious. Check the user activity on the same agent at that time. Check if the host is a development server. Check if this installation was related to more installations at the same time. Check for additional file/network operations by the same process instance.
name: Linux process execution with a rare GitHub URL
